# ARTINEXT

> ARTINEXT is a digital-systems studio based in Tehran, Iran, working remotely with architecture, structural and MEP teams. It builds custom Revit content (parametric families, office libraries, library audits), custom digital tools (Revit plugins and add-ins, model QA/QC checkers, Dynamo scripts, model and data conversion tools) and office and workflow automation (software and data integration, operational dashboards). The site is bilingual: Persian at `/fa/` (the default) and English at `/en/`, with matching paths.

Every project starts from the client's own process, not a pre-built product. The studio states plainly that it is not a fit for installing an off-the-shelf template or a generic plugin without a process review, and it gives no price or estimate before the problem has been stated in full. Clients own what gets built; source and build instructions are handed over.

## Services

- [Revit plugin development](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-plugin-development/): Custom Revit plugins and add-ins for architecture, structural and MEP teams, studied against how the team actually works before any code is written. Covers the three problems plugins are bought to fix and the four things that set the size of the job.
- [Revit family creation](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-family-creation/): Parametric, lightweight Revit families for manufacturers and design offices, tested against the combinations that break content. Built work: a curtain-wall system delivered as two panel types on one shared frame.
- [Office automation for AEC companies](https://artinext.ir/en/aec-workflow-automation/): Office and workflow automation, software and data integration and operational dashboards for AEC companies and technical offices. Not Revit-specific; built work: one dashboard structure for two offices in two languages.

## Tehran

- [Revit plugin development in Tehran](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-plugin-development-tehran/): The plugin service for Tehran offices, with discovery and handover available in person.
- [Revit family creation in Tehran](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-family-creation-tehran/): The family service for Tehran manufacturers and offices, where the product can be measured in person rather than reconstructed from a brochure.
- [Office automation in Tehran](https://artinext.ir/en/workflow-automation-tehran/): The automation service for Tehran companies, including installation on the office's own network and in-person training.

## Studio

- [Home](https://artinext.ir/en/): Three frictions found in almost every office, three product paths, two tools recorded running (CAD to Revit, ETABS to Revit), the four-stage process (discover, define, build, evolve) and common questions.
- [Products](https://artinext.ir/en/products/): Three deliverables shown as they shipped: Revit families, tools on the Revit ribbon, and one office automation system.
- [Research and development](https://artinext.ir/en/research-development/): Staged prototyping. The measure of success is written down before anything is built, and one possible outcome is not building it.
- [About](https://artinext.ir/en/about/): The software the studio works in (Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, Rhino, Grasshopper, Dynamo) and what it does in each.
- [Contact](https://artinext.ir/en/contact/): Project brief form. Email artinext.ai@gmail.com, phone +98 930 525 3240, Instagram @artinext.ir.

## Articles

- [Articles index](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/): All articles, fa and en.
- [Choosing a Revit plugin development company: what actually matters](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-plugin-development-company/): Company, freelancer or in-house; the questions to ask before signing; comparing two quotes on scope rather than total.
- [Custom Dynamo script development: what it actually replaces](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/custom-dynamo-script-development/): What a Dynamo graph replaces, how to build one other people can run, what Revit upgrades do to packages, and when a graph should become an add-in.
- [Where AEC workflow automation should start](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/aec-workflow-automation/): Choosing the first process, writing it down, fixing the data behind it and piloting it before switching over.
- [Custom parametric Revit family creation: what makes a family actually work](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/custom-parametric-revit-family-creation/): Type and instance parameters, reference planes, formulas, and testing beyond a single flex.
- [How much does Revit plugin development cost?](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-plugin-development-cost/): The drivers behind plugin pricing (workflow complexity, integrations, user count, Revit versions) instead of a price list.
- [A Revit model checker automates QA/QC. It doesn't replace it.](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-model-checker/): Autodesk's Model Checker, building a checkset, triaging flags, and when a custom checker is the next step.
- [Revit library optimization isn't about deleting files](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-library-optimization/): Purging, downloaded content, object styles, a written library standard and a recurring audit.
